I have farmed this land since I was a boy, and my father taught me everything I know. This plot is my main field near the house, so I will put my coupon fertilizer here — one bag of NPK when I plant, and one bag of urea when the maize is knee-high. I will plant the hybrid seed from the program because it fills the granary better than the local maize, and that is what my neighbors do. I am too old to bend and weed all day now, so my children and grandchildren will work this plot, and I will pay some young men from the village to help with the heavy digging and the weeding. We do not spray chemicals on food maize in this village, and we have no water for irrigation — we wait for the rains like we always have.
